scripts.build:frontend: tsc --noEmit && mkdir -p static/dist && esbuild static/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=static/dist/app.js && cp static/src/styles.css static/app.css
scripts.electron:prepare: npm run build:frontend && node node_modules/electron/install.js && node scripts/prepare-electron-sidecars.mjs
scripts.electron:check: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check scripts/run-electron.mjs && node --test electron/*.test.cjs
